title: frame.intersect(rect)
evidence: Original CrossingMaxIterationsReached defect fixed and covered by portable endpoint-crossing regressions. After the fix, both backends return NonAffineOverlapCorrespondence for the original fixture and reduced touching cubic rectangles; equivalent Line rectangles succeed. User accepted the remaining overlap-correspondence failure as an API limitation on 2026-10-12. No further fix planned for this fixture.
